python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile, shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_new.xlsx'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
sheet = zin.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
styles = zin.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')

def must_replace(text, old, new, expected=1):
    cnt = text.count(old)
    assert cnt == expected, f"Expected {expected} occurrence(s) of {old!r}, found {cnt}"
    return text.replace(old, new)

# --- sheet1.xml ---
sheet = must_replace(sheet, '<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>')
sheet = must_replace(sheet,
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>')
sheet = must_replace(sheet,
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c></row>')
for r in range(2, 10):
    sheet = must_replace(sheet,
        f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>',
        f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c><c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>')
sheet = must_replace(sheet,
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>',
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c><c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>')

# --- styles.xml ---
styles = must_replace(styles,
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>')
styles = must_replace(styles, '<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">')
styles = must_replace(styles,
    '</cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/><xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>')

# --- rebuild xlsx ---
with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            data = sheet.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            data = styles.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)
zin.close()
shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print('Saved.')

# --- verify ---
z = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
assert 'ref="A1:H10"' in xml
assert 'Profit Margin' in xml
for r in range(2, 10):
    assert f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f>' in xml, f"H{r} missing"
assert '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f>' in xml
sx = z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8')
assert 'numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"' in sx
assert '<cellXfs count="5">' in sx
print('All checks passed.')
EOF
